Help · Name the local kind cluster

Enter       use
Backspace   erase
Esc         close
F1          help
Ctrl+C      exit

Type the local kind cluster's name: Enter uses it and runs
the checks again, Esc keeps the name it had. ? is part of a
name here, so F1 opens help. Nothing has been changed yet:
